besluite.fout: 'n eie fietswinkel' is stiff; Afrikaans naturally says 'hul eie'.
besluite.rede: Same meaning, and 'hul eie fietswinkel' is the natural possessive a fluent writer would use.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'Jy moet ook kan draai' and 'jy moet die vliegtuig reguit kan hou' are two full sentences joined by 'en', so the AWS comma is required.

besluite.fout: Without 'dat' the clause has verb-final word order, which is ungrammatical in a main-clause complement.
besluite.rede: Adding 'dat' makes the existing word order correct without changing what beheer means.

besluite.fout: 'by die grond geëindig' is an unnatural preposition for where a glide ends.
besluite.rede: In both versions the glide starts on a dune and ends when it reaches the ground; 'op die grond' is the natural preposition and the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'in plaas van om ... te' is the colloquial form; the standard form before an om-clause is 'in plaas daarvan om'.
besluite.rede: A plain grammar correction with no change in meaning.

besluite.fout: 'die hoogte was op' is an odd, easily misread use of 'op' for 'used up'.
besluite.rede: 'opgebruik' says plainly that the height was spent, which is exactly what the original meant, and a Grade 4 reader will not stumble on it.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'Een van die broers was self aan boord' and 'hy kon die vliegtuig stuur' are two full sentences joined by 'en'.

besluite.fout: 'Hy' can be read as the brother who was 'hy' two sentences earlier, and 'het gemaak dat' is wooden.
besluite.rede: Naming the engine removes the pronoun doubt; 'wel' only marks the contrast with the previous 'nie', so the same engine still does the same thing.

besluite.fout: The repeated 'het' makes the coordinated verb phrase clumsy.
besluite.rede: One 'het' governs both verbs; the people and actions are unchanged and the sentence reads more smoothly.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'Nuwe enjins was sterker' and 'vlieëniers kon hul masjiene beter beheer' are two full sentences joined by 'en'.

besluite.fout: The possessive 'aan 'n voël of vliegtuig se sy' is awkward.
besluite.rede: This is a glossary definition and the change rewords it beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may change it, for every lesson at once.
